scenarios.description: Static full-page renders at multiple resolutions.
Visible but gentle motion with stable identity and quiet loop boundary.
Viewport pan/zoom stress without full-page repainting.
Moderate frame-scale or element-frame-scale layout stress.
Strong frame-scale or element-frame-scale resize/reposition stress.
Coarse page regions move and resize independently on separate timelines.
Stronger independent page-region motion with separate speeds, pans, and scales.
The model learns independent multi-region motion directly from x,y,t without a render-time layout transform.
Smooth independent page-region translation with local pans only; scale/stretch is disabled.
Stronger smooth independent page-region translation with local pans only; scale/stretch is disabled.
The model learns independent local translations directly from x,y,t without render-time stretch or scale.
The model learns region-level sprite translations directly from x,y,t; the output is still a direct neural canvas render.
The model learns a full page layout reflow: illustration is resized/repositioned and text/content blocks move to a new layout.
